title: A股港股早报：油价与半导体分化压制风险偏好，能源防御和国产算力待验证

entries.summary: 霍尔木兹航运风险推动布伦特原油周五上涨1.7%至88.52美元，美股三大指数小幅回落；RDDT因纳入标普500上涨12.6%，但AMAT、Broadcom和Oracle显著承压。A/H今日以能源防御、国产算力和事件型科技为主，重点验证中际旭创、海光信息、吉利汽车和高伟电子的承接。
entries.summary_en: Hormuz shipping risk lifted Brent 1.7% to $88.52 on Friday while the three major US indexes slipped. RDDT jumped 12.6% on S&P 500 inclusion, but AMAT, Broadcom and Oracle came under marked pressure. A/H trading should favor energy hedges, domestic compute and event-driven technology, with support in ZJ Innolight, Hygon, Geely Auto and Cowell the key test.
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
霍尔木兹两艘油轮遇袭，能源与航运尾险升温
美联社8月14日报道，两艘阿联酋油轮在霍尔木兹海峡航行时遭无人机袭击；周五布伦特原油上涨1.7%至88.52美元。事实利多中海油、油服与部分航运，但利空高估值成长和航空化工等成本敏感行业。
国际
美伊谈判期限临近仍无延期，区域风险溢价难消
美联社8月16日报道，6月17日开始的60天谈判期临近结束仍未见延期，美国中央司令部司令结束区域访问并登上长期部署的林肯号航母。外交突破仍有可能，但开盘前应按高不确定性处理。
科技
隔夜科技异动分化：指数事件领涨，设备和云基建领跌
Futunn/Moomoo实时排行抓取受限；已核验公开行情显示RDDT因纳入标普500上涨12.6%，AMD盘中约涨4.1%，而AMAT跌5.1%、Broadcom跌5.8%、Oracle跌3.6%。A/H映射偏向事件驱动与国产算力，海外高预期设备链需先看承接。
科技
AMD相对强而Broadcom承压，AI芯片从普涨转向筛选
公开行情样本显示AMD在并购完成与AI需求叙事支持下盘中约涨4.1%，Broadcom则受分析师压力下跌5.8%。A股海光信息、寒武纪等设计链若高开有量可获映射，设备与ASIC高估值方向不宜无差别追涨。
科技
AMAT业绩超预期仍跌5.1%，半导体设备面临卖事实
Applied Materials季度利润与收入均好于预期，管理层仍强调AI需求，但股价周五下跌5.1%；这表明估值和前期涨幅压过基本面利好。北方华创、中微公司及设备材料链需要成交和订单验证。
科技
Oracle下跌3.6%，数据中心扩张延迟压制云基建情绪
公开报道将Oracle约3.6%的下跌与分析师压力及新墨西哥数据中心天然气管线延至2027年联系起来。中际旭创、液冷、电源和服务器映射仍有长期逻辑，但短线必须防资本开支节奏和能源配套延迟。
财报
联想上周业绩强反馈仍支撑港股AI硬件
联想8月13日披露季度业绩后，公开报道显示其在AI基础设施需求与创纪录收入支持下获得强价格反馈；该结果仍可为0992.HK和港股硬件链提供本地验证，但周五美国硬件分化要求避免机械追高。
财报
京东业绩超预期后的负反馈继续约束平台互联网
京东二季度收入约3464亿元、非GAAP净利约89亿元并好于预期，但ADR在披露后明显下跌。9618.HK若不能修复，将继续压制恒生科技平台权重；若低开后放量回升，才构成情绪改善信号。
财报
新窗口可验证A/H财报结果不足，今日先看业绩日程
Futu OpenD的HK/SH/SZ日历与NOTICE搜索因本机连接权限受限未返回；HKEX董事会日历显示吉利汽车、高伟电子、上海复旦等8月17日审议业绩，但盘前尚不能当作已披露结果，更不能用纯美股财报补位。

盘前结论

事实层面，标普500、道指和纳指周五分别约跌0.2%、0.2%和0.3%，10年期美债收益率升至4.69%，布伦特原油涨1.7%，A/H开盘环境偏谨慎。但RDDT指数纳入与AMD相对强势表明资金没有撤离科技，而是在事件驱动、盈利确定性和高估值设备之间重新筛选。

判断上，A股更可能平开后分化，能源、防务与国产算力相对占优；港股恒生科技先受美股云基建和半导体压力约束，再看联想、京东以及今日业绩日程个股能否提供承接。

不确定性来自周末中东局势、Futunn/Moomoo排行抓取失败和Futu OpenD子项受限；若油价继续上冲且科技高开无量，应降仓追涨，若油价回落且国产算力放量，则可提高成长方向权重。

重点个股推荐

海光信息
688041.SH
国产算力

推荐理由：AMD相对强于设备和ASIC链，市场更偏好有需求支撑的计算芯片设计。

触发因素：若科创芯片指数走强且海光放量突破周五高点，映射逻辑得到确认。

风险点：Broadcom和AMAT下跌显示AI估值拥挤，高开无量容易回落。

中际旭创
300308.SZ
CPO验证

推荐理由：AI数据中心长期需求仍在，光模块是A股最直接的海外算力映射之一。

触发因素：若AMD强势扩散到服务器/CPO且中际旭创成交额同步放大，可考虑顺势。

风险点：Oracle项目延迟和高估值设备回落提示资本开支节奏风险，不宜盲目追高。

中国海洋石油
0883.HK
能源对冲

推荐理由：霍尔木兹航运事件与布伦特上涨提高上游能源现金流和防御价值。

触发因素：亚洲盘油价继续站稳88美元附近且港股能源板块放量。

风险点：外交进展或通道恢复会快速压低风险溢价，能源股可能高开低走。

吉利汽车
0175.HK
业绩观察

推荐理由：HKEX日历显示今日审议中期业绩，是港股汽车权重的本地事件窗口。

触发因素：公告中的收入、利润率和指引超预期，且股价在成交放大下转强。

风险点：盘前尚未披露结果；价格战、促销和海外成本可能压制利润率。

高伟电子
1415.HK
消费电子观察

推荐理由：今日业绩日程为消费电子链提供本地验证，适合等待公告后的价格反馈。

触发因素：若利润率、客户需求与新产品指引改善，并带动港股硬件链扩散。

风险点：美股科技分化和终端需求不确定，未披露前不应把预期当作事实。

板块轮动看板

受益方向上游能源与油服、国产算力、事件型指数纳入映射、具备业绩验证的港股硬件。
观察方向CPO光通信、服务器电源液冷、吉利汽车与高伟电子业绩日、平台互联网修复。
压力方向半导体设备、ASIC高估值、海外云基建、航空化工及其他油价成本敏感板块。
验证信号布伦特能否站稳88美元、海光与中际成交额、0883.HK高开承接、恒生科技相对恒指强弱。

逻辑链

霍尔木兹油轮遇袭推动布伦特上涨并抬高美债收益率，A/H成长估值先受压。
美股指数小幅回落，但RDDT与AMD相对强，说明资金转向事件驱动和有需求支撑的计算芯片。
AMAT、Broadcom与Oracle下跌，映射A/H设备、ASIC、CPO和云基建需要从普涨切换到个股验证。
能源风险溢价映射中海油与油服，国产算力映射海光信息，今日业绩日映射吉利和高伟电子。
若油价回落且科技龙头放量，成长可修复；若油价继续上冲而科技缩量，资金更可能转向能源防御。

风险雷达

中东升级

海峡再受袭或谈判破裂会推高油价、通胀和航运成本。

AI估值兑现

AMAT与Broadcom的大幅下跌可能扩散到A/H高估值设备和光通信。

云基建延迟

Oracle项目能源配套延迟提示数据中心资本开支并非线性兑现。

业绩前置交易

吉利与高伟电子盘前尚未披露结果，预期过满可能导致卖事实。

数据源降级

Sparks实时排行和Futu OpenD子项受限，板块样本不等同完整排行。

数据来源与时间点

来源：AP关于8月14日美股收盘、零售销售、布伦特原油、10年期美债、RDDT与AMAT，以及8月14-16日霍尔木兹和美伊局势报道；HKEX董事会会议日历（8月13日抓取页面，覆盖8月17-19日）；公开市场报道关于AMD、Broadcom与Oracle。抓取截止2026-08-17 09:06 CST。Futunn/Moomoo Sparks实时排行因403及浏览器权限受限未取得，panel使用已核验公开行情样本；Futu OpenD HK/SH/SZ日历与NOTICE搜索因127.0.0.1连接受限，按规则降级继续。
entries.html_en:
Major News Summary
Global
Two tankers attacked in Hormuz, lifting energy and shipping tail risk
AP reported on Aug. 14 that two UAE tankers were hit by drones while transiting the Strait of Hormuz; Brent rose 1.7% Friday to $88.52. The fact pattern favors CNOOC, oil services and some shipping names, but hurts high-duration growth and fuel-cost-sensitive airlines and chemicals.
Global
US-Iran negotiating window nears expiry without an extension
AP reported on Aug. 16 that the 60-day negotiating period begun June 17 was nearing its end with no extension announced, while the US Central Command chief completed a regional tour and visited the long-deployed USS Lincoln. A diplomatic breakthrough remains possible, but the opening setup carries high uncertainty.
Tech
Overnight tech split: index event led while equipment and cloud infrastructure lagged
Live Futunn/Moomoo rankings were unavailable. Verified public tape showed RDDT up 12.6% on S&P 500 inclusion and AMD about 4.1% higher intraday, while AMAT fell 5.1%, Broadcom 5.8% and Oracle 3.6%. The A/H read-through favors event-driven names and domestic compute, while high-expectation equipment needs support first.
Tech
AMD held relative strength as Broadcom weakened, turning AI chips selective
Public market samples showed AMD about 4.1% higher intraday after an acquisition close and amid sustained AI demand, while Broadcom fell 5.8% under analyst pressure. Hygon and Cambricon can benefit if they gap higher on volume; equipment and high-multiple ASIC names should not be chased indiscriminately.
Tech
AMAT beat but fell 5.1%, signaling sell-the-news pressure in equipment
Applied Materials beat quarterly profit and revenue expectations and still cited AI demand, yet its shares dropped 5.1% Friday. Valuation and prior gains outweighed the good fundamentals, so NAURA, AMEC and the equipment-materials chain need volume and order confirmation.
Tech
Oracle fell 3.6% as a data-center delay weighed on cloud infrastructure
Public reporting linked Oracle's roughly 3.6% decline to analyst pressure and a New Mexico gas pipeline for a data center being delayed to 2027. ZJ Innolight, liquid cooling, power and servers retain long-run logic, but capex timing and energy-infrastructure delays are near-term risks.
Earnings
Lenovo's strong earnings reaction still supports Hong Kong AI hardware
Lenovo reported quarterly results on Aug. 13 and public reporting cited AI infrastructure demand and record revenue behind a strong price reaction. That remains a local validation for 0992.HK and Hong Kong hardware, but Friday's US hardware split argues against mechanical chasing.
Earnings
JD's negative post-beat feedback continues to constrain platform internet
JD reported roughly RMB346.4 billion in second-quarter revenue and about RMB8.9 billion in non-GAAP profit, both above expectations, but its ADR fell sharply after the release. Failure by 9618.HK to repair would keep weighing on Hang Seng Tech platform weights; a high-volume rebound would be the improvement signal.
Earnings
Few verifiable new A/H results; today's earnings calendar is the focus
Futu OpenD HK/SH/SZ calendars and NOTICE searches returned no data because local connectivity was restricted. The HKEX board-meeting calendar lists Geely Auto, Cowell and Shanghai Fudan for Aug. 17, but their pre-open status cannot be treated as disclosed results, and US earnings must not fill the gap.

Pre-market Takeaway

On the facts, the S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq fell about 0.2%, 0.2% and 0.3% Friday, the 10-year yield rose to 4.69%, and Brent gained 1.7%, leaving a cautious A/H opening setup.But RDDT's inclusion move and AMD's relative strength show that money did not abandon tech; it is rotating among event catalysts, earnings certainty and expensive equipment.

Our base case is a flat, highly differentiated A-share open with energy, defense and domestic compute relatively firm; Hang Seng Tech may first absorb US cloud and semiconductor pressure, then trade on support in Lenovo, JD and today's earnings-calendar names.

Uncertainty comes from weekend Middle East developments, failed live Futunn/Moomoo ranking access and constrained Futu OpenD checks. If oil extends higher and tech gaps without volume, avoid chasing; if oil eases and domestic compute expands on volume, growth exposure can rise.

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicates heat/importance, not percentage move.

Focus Stocks

Hygon Information
688041.SH
Domestic Compute

Thesis: AMD outperformed equipment and ASIC names, favoring compute-chip design with demand support.

Trigger: Hygon clears Friday's high on volume while the STAR chip index strengthens.

Risk: Broadcom and AMAT show crowded AI valuation; a low-volume gap can fade.

ZJ Innolight
300308.SZ
CPO Check

Thesis: Long-run AI data-center demand remains intact, and optics is one of A-shares' clearest overseas-compute mappings.

Trigger: AMD strength broadens to servers and CPO while ZJ Innolight turnover expands.

Risk: Oracle's delay and equipment weakness flag capex-timing risk; do not chase blindly.

CNOOC
0883.HK
Energy Hedge

Thesis: Hormuz shipping risk and a higher Brent price improve upstream cash-flow sensitivity and defensive value.

Trigger: Asian-session Brent holds near $88 and Hong Kong energy turnover expands.

Risk: Diplomatic progress or restored transit can quickly compress the risk premium and reverse a gap.

Geely Auto
0175.HK
Earnings Watch

Thesis: The HKEX calendar shows an interim-results review today, creating a local event window in a major auto weight.

Trigger: Revenue, margins and guidance beat expectations and the stock strengthens on higher volume.

Risk: Results were not disclosed pre-open; price competition, promotions and overseas costs may pressure margins.

Cowell e Holdings
1415.HK
Consumer Tech Watch

Thesis: Today's results calendar offers local validation for the consumer-electronics chain after the filing.

Trigger: Better margins, customer demand and product guidance broaden strength across Hong Kong hardware.

Risk: US tech divergence and uncertain device demand mean expectations are not facts before disclosure.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesUpstream energy and services, domestic compute, index-event mappings and Hong Kong hardware with earnings validation.
WatchlistCPO optics, server power and cooling, Geely and Cowell earnings days, and platform-internet repair.
PressureSemiconductor equipment, high-multiple ASIC, overseas cloud infrastructure, airlines, chemicals and other oil-cost-sensitive groups.
ConfirmationBrent holding $88, turnover in Hygon and ZJ Innolight, opening support in 0883.HK, and Hang Seng Tech relative to the Hang Seng.

Logic Chain

Hormuz tanker attacks lifted Brent and Treasury yields, first pressuring A/H growth valuations.
US indexes slipped, but RDDT and AMD outperformed, showing rotation toward events and compute chips with demand support.
AMAT, Broadcom and Oracle fell, so A/H equipment, ASIC, CPO and cloud mappings must move from broad beta to stock-level confirmation.
The energy premium maps to CNOOC and oil services, domestic compute to Hygon, and today's earnings calendar to Geely and Cowell.
If oil eases and tech leaders expand on volume, growth can recover; if oil extends higher and tech volume fades, money should rotate toward energy defense.

Risk Radar

Middle East escalation

Fresh strait attacks or failed talks would lift oil, inflation and shipping costs.

AI valuation unwind

Sharp losses in AMAT and Broadcom can spill into high-multiple A/H equipment and optics.

Cloud infrastructure delay

Oracle's energy-infrastructure delay shows data-center capex is not linear.

Pre-positioned earnings

Geely and Cowell had not disclosed pre-open, so full expectations can produce sell-the-news reactions.

Degraded data sources

Live Sparks and Futu OpenD checks were constrained, so sector samples are not a complete ranking.

Sources and Timestamp

Sources: AP coverage of the Aug. 14 US close, retail sales, Brent, the US 10-year yield, RDDT and AMAT, plus Aug. 14-16 Hormuz and US-Iran developments; HKEX board-meeting calendar page captured Aug. 13 and covering Aug. 17-19; public market reporting on AMD, Broadcom and Oracle. Cutoff: 2026-08-17 09:06 CST. Live Futunn/Moomoo Sparks rankings were unavailable because of 403/browser permission limits, so the panel uses verified public tape samples; Futu OpenD HK/SH/SZ calendar and NOTICE searches were unavailable because localhost access was restricted, and the task continued under the degrade rule.
